segments.ja324:1.1: Kalyāṇarūpo vatayaṃ catuppado, subhaddako ceva supesalo ca;
segments.ja324:1.3: Yo brāhmaṇaṃ jātimantūpapannaṃ, apacāyati meṇḍavaro yasassī.
segments.ja324:3.1: Ūruṭṭhi [ūraṭṭhi (sī.)] bhaggaṃ pavaṭṭito [patito (sī. syā.)] khāribhāro, sabbañca bhaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇassa [brāhmaṇassīdha (ka. sī. pī.), brāhmaṇasseva (ka. sī. syā. ka.)] bhinnaṃ;
segments.ja324:3.3: Ubhopi bāhā paggayha [paggayyeva (syā.), paggahīya (?)] kandati [bāhā paggayya kandati (pī. ka.)], abhidhāvatha haññate brahmacārī.
segments.ja324:4.1: Evaṃ so nihato seti, yo apūjaṃ pasaṃsati [namassati (pī.)];

lines: Tasmiṃ khaṇe āpaṇe nisinno paṇḍitavāṇijo taṃ paribbājakaṃ nisedhento dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Tassa paṇḍitavāṇijassa kathentasseva so meṇḍako vegenāgantvā ūrumhi paharitvā taṃ tattheva vedanāppattaṃ katvā pātesi.
Satthā taṃ kāraṇaṃ pakāsento tatiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Ūruṭṭhi bhaggaṃ vaṭṭito khāribhāro, sabbañca bhaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇassa bhinnaṃ;
Ubhopi bāhā paggayha kandati, atidhāvatha haññate brahmacārī”ti.

Tassattho – bhikkhave, tassa paribbājakassa ūruṭṭhikaṃ bhaggaṃ, khāribhāro vaṭṭito pavaṭṭito, tasmiṃ pavaṭṭamāne yaṃ tattha tassa brāhmaṇassa upakaraṇabhaṇḍaṃ, tampi sabbaṃ bhinnaṃ, sopi ubho bāhā ukkhipitvā parivāretvā ṭhitaparisaṃ sandhāya “abhidhāvatha, haññate brahmacārī”ti vadanto kandati rodati paridevatīti.
“Evaṃ so nihato seti, yo apūjaṃ pasaṃsati;
Yathāhamajjāti yathā ahaṃ ajja asantapaggahaṃ katvā ṭhito meṇḍena daḷhappahārena pahato ettheva mārito.
Evaṃ yo aññopi asantapaggahaṃ karissati, sopi ahaṃ viya dukkhaṃ anubhavissatīti so paridevanto tattheva jīvitakkhayaṃ pattoti.
